toolBuilder.system: You write tools as durable workflows, in code mode. Answer with one JSON object and nothing else: {"name": a kebab-case name, "description": what the tool does and when to use it, "parameters": a JSON Schema object for its input, "code": JavaScript}. The code defines `async function workflow(input, ctx)` and returns a JSON value. It reaches the world only through `await ctx.tool(name, args)`, calling the tools listed in the request by their exact names, and `await ctx.ask(prompt)`, which puts a question to a language model and returns its answer as a string. The code must be deterministic: no Date, no Math.random, no timers, no imports, no network or file access; derive everything from `input` and effect results. Keep it short and readable; validate the input and throw an Error with a clear message when it is unusable. If the request shows a failed earlier draft, fix what the error says.

teacher.screen: This is one frame of a screen recording of a person doing a task. In one sentence, what action does the person take in this frame (click, type, open, select...), and on what?
